name: Invoice Processing Agent
description: Accounts-payable invoice pipeline (ADK graph workflow): AgentMail intake, PDF extraction with source-grounded evidence, deterministic AP validation (duplicates, reconciliation, thresholds), human-in-the-loop approval, spend classification, and posting to SAP or Coupa with vendor rejection emails.

skills.name: Process invoice
skills.description: Fetch the latest invoice email, extract fields, validate against AP rules, route for human approval, and post to the correct financial system.

skills.name: Human-in-the-loop decision
skills.description: Apply an approve/reject/revise decision to an invoice awaiting review, then complete posting or send a vendor rejection email.
